caseName: United States v. Atlanta Journal Co.
caseNameFull: The United States, in Error v. Atlanta Journal Company
summary: In error to the Circuit Court of the United States for the Northern District of Georgia.
attorneys: The Attorney General and Mr. Assistant Attorney General Harr for the plaintiff in error., Mr. Alex. C. King and Mr. Chas. T. Hopkins for the defendant in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for the want of jurisdiction, on the authority of United States v. Patten, 226 U. S. 525, 535, and cases cited, and cause remanded to the District Court of the United States for the Northern District of Georgia.
